caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet or secretary desk with multiple compartments. The cabinet is colored in various shades of light brown and tan, simulating the appearance of wood grain. The top section consists of two compartments; the left compartment is open to reveal three shelves inside, while the right compartment is closed with two paneled doors, each having a round knob. Below the top section, the left side features two open shelves with vertical dividers below the lower shelf, designed to hold documents or letters. The right side below the top has another closed compartment with paneled double doors and a round knob. The middle area includes a drop-down desk surface, which is partially open and supported by hinges. The lower section of the cabinet contains six drawers, each with a round knob, arranged in two columns of three drawers each. The background is a plain, light beige color, and there are minimal markings aside from some small handwritten notes in the bottom left corner of the image.
title: Desk
